units.text: # Reachy 2

Reachy 2 is an open-source humanoid robot made by Pollen Robotics, specifically designed for the development of embodied AI and real-world applications.
Check out [Pollen Robotics website](⟦0⟧), or access [Reachy 2 documentation](⟦1⟧) for more information on the platform!
## Teleoperate Reachy 2
Currently, there are two ways to teleoperate Reachy 2:
- Pollen Robotics’ VR teleoperation (not included in LeRobot).
- Robot-to-robot teleoperation (use one Reachy 2 to control another).

## Step 1: Recording
### Get Reachy 2 IP address

Before starting teleoperation and data recording, find the [robot's IP address](⟦0⟧).
We strongly recommend connecting all devices (PC and robot) via **Ethernet**.
### Launch recording
Use LeRobot's ⟦0⟧ command to manage recording sessions. The ⟦1⟧ workflow previously documented here is no longer available.
When using the Reachy 2 VR teleoperation application, choose "Standard session". The VR application controls the robot's motion, while ⟦0⟧ manages the dataset and starts and stops episodes.
